name: @jadwigo/docs
description: The living docs at docs.jadwigo.pl: Starlight, static, English, generated from the code where it can be

scripts.check:dist: bun scripts/check-dist.ts && REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly lint public/openapi.json

//.astro: builds the static site that Starlight runs in (astro.config.mjs)
//.@astrojs/starlight: the docs theme: sidebar, search, the docs content collection (astro.config.mjs, src/content.config.ts)
//.@astrojs/markdown-remark: Starlight's peer dependency for its markdown pipeline
//.starlight-links-validator: fails the build on a broken internal link (astro.config.mjs)
//.starlight-openapi: renders the API reference from public/openapi.json, which scripts/prepare.ts writes (astro.config.mjs)
//.@astrojs/markdown-satteri: starlight-openapi's peer dependency for rendering the OpenAPI descriptions
//.satteri: left external in the Vite build (astro.config.mjs) so its native binding resolves from apps/docs/node_modules; knip.json ignores it
//.starlight-llms-txt: writes llms.txt, llms-full.txt and llms-small.txt for agents (astro.config.mjs)
//.starlight-llm-actions: the page-actions menu, each page's .md and its rel=alternate link (astro.config.mjs, src/components/PageTitle.astro)
//.@astrojs/mdx: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.unified: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.rehype-parse: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.rehype-remark: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.remark-gfm: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.remark-stringify: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.hast-util-select: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.unist-util-remove: an optional peer of starlight-llm-actions that its renderMarkdown 'simple' needs to flatten a rendered page to Markdown; the plugin loads it at build time
//.markdownlint-cli2: lints every page under src/content/docs in this package's lint script (.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc)
//.@redocly/cli: lints the served public/openapi.json in check:dist (redocly.yaml)
//.@astrojs/check: type-checks the .astro and .mdx files in this package's typecheck script
//.@types/node: Node 24 types for this package's typecheck (tsconfig.base.json names them)
//.typescript: tsc for this package's typecheck script
//.vitest: runs this package's unit tests with the root vitest.config.ts
//.@jadwigo/config: hosts.prod.docs and hosts.prod.app: the site's own URL and the API's base URL (src/index.ts)
//.@jadwigo/contracts: ERROR_STATUS, ROUTES and ROUTE_TAGS: the guides' generated tables, the guide path test and the API reference's tags (src/lib); the schemas each MCP tool's output follows (src/lib/mcp-output.ts); its src/index.ts, read by starlight-typedoc for the TypeScript client pages
//.@jadwigo/cli: mcp-tools.json, read as a file by prepare.ts and the MCP pages; the edge makes turbo --affected rerun the docs on a CLI change; nothing imports it, so knip.json ignores it
//.@jadwigo/lesson-kit: QUESTION_TYPES, the source of the Question types page's table (src/lib/question-types.ts)
//.@jadwigo/ui: foundation.css, whose folder holds every stylesheet the Tokens page lists (src/lib/tokens.ts); turbo.json lists them as inputs
//.astro-mermaid: turns each mermaid code block in the architecture pages into a diagram, drawn in the reader's browser (astro.config.mjs)
//.mermaid: astro-mermaid's peer dependency: the library that draws the diagrams, bundled into the page's script
//.happy-dom: the DOM mermaid needs to parse each diagram in src/lib/diagrams.test.ts, and the DOM src/theme.test.ts runs the theme bridge in
//.@fontsource/andika: Andika, the docs' face for body and headings, loaded through customCss in astro.config.mjs
//.starlight-image-zoom: opens a content image full size on click (astro.config.mjs)
//.@expressive-code/plugin-collapsible-sect: folds the lines a long code sample names in collapse={...} (ec.config.mjs)
//.@expressive-code/plugin-line-numbers: numbers a code block's lines when it asks with showLineNumbers (ec.config.mjs)
//.starlight-auto-sidebar: orders the autogenerated MCP tools group from src/content/docs/mcp/_meta.yml (astro.config.mjs, src/content.config.ts)
//.starlight-heading-badges: draws a heading's :badge[...] in the page and its table of contents (astro.config.mjs)
//.starlight-typedoc: renders the TypeScript client pages under /typescript/ from api-client's and contracts' src/index.ts (astro.config.mjs)
//.typedoc: starlight-typedoc's peer dependency: reads each package's public surface, with the options in typedoc.json
//.typedoc-plugin-markdown: starlight-typedoc's peer dependency: writes typedoc's pages as Markdown for Starlight
//.@jadwigo/api-client: its src/index.ts, read by starlight-typedoc for the TypeScript client pages; the edge makes turbo --affected rerun the docs on a client change; nothing imports it, so knip.json ignores it
